name: Flare Stack
status: frozen implementation specification (review-complete: draft-Worker secret bootstrap, production auth allowlist isolation, single-build Workers Builds path)
goal: Cloudflare-first startup pack with a few proven project shapes, exact pinned dependencies, local quality gates, structured observability, isolated environments, recoverable lifecycle commands, and simple Cloudflare deployment without default testing-framework bloat.

fullstack.browser_origin: apps/web Worker is the single public browser origin

networking.production: apps/web forwards /api/* to apps/server through a Cloudflare Service Binding; server is not publicly exposed
networking.local: Cloudflare Vite auxiliaryWorkers runs web + server locally through the same Service Binding topology
networking.better_auth_cookie_model: first-party cookie on the web origin
networking.preview: persistent Wrangler env.preview pair: web-preview -> server-preview; no branch Worker Previews in v1
networking.forward_request: forward original Request object via env.SERVER.fetch(request)
networking.better_auth_base_url: browser-facing web origin in local, preview, and production

fullstack.type_dependency: apps/web declares apps/server as an explicit workspace dependency for type-only Hono AppType imports

extension.backend_policy: extension-only in v1; backend is a separate worker/fullstack Flare project

d1.local_persistence: repo-root .wrangler/state shared by Vite persistState and Wrangler --persist-to

neon.reason: transaction-capable baseline for Better Auth; release-tested on Cloudflare Workers
neon.client_lifecycle: request scoped; create pool/db inside request, perform work, then invoke pool.end() in finally and schedule its promise with ctx.waitUntil
neon.vendor_guidance: Neon and Cloudflare recommend Hyperdrive + native pg/Postgres.js on Workers
neon.v1_default: neon-serverless kept deliberately (no extra Cloudflare resource); documented trade-off

hyperdrive_recipe.driver: pg or Postgres.js + matching Drizzle driver
hyperdrive_recipe.binding: hyperdrive per environment; no runtime DATABASE_URL secret
hyperdrive_recipe.switch_default_if: fixture shows connection errors, unacceptable latency, or Better Auth transaction problems

neon.client_factory: withDb(env, ctx, run): create Pool + Drizzle per request; await run(db); finally ctx.waitUntil(pool.end())
neon.fixture: two consecutive deployed requests plus Better Auth request prove no premature cleanup or cross-request connection reuse

auth.transaction_policy: Neon uses transaction-capable driver; D1 Better Auth + Drizzle behavior is release-fixture-gated on pinned versions instead of inventing custom adapter semantics

rate_limit.fixture: must limit across separate Worker requests/isolate executions
rate_limit.enabled: explicit true (never rely on environment-mode default)
rate_limit.reason_get_session_exempt: avoid a DB write on every session check (D1 row-write quota)
rate_limit.defaults_kept: global 60s/100; Better Auth stricter sign-in rules; IPv6 /64

base_url.unknown_hosts: fail closed; no fallback by default
base_url.setup: flare setup cloudflare resolves production workers.dev host, preview_url_suffix/persistent preview host, and configured custom domains
base_url.single_worker_preview_pattern: *-<worker-name>.<account-subdomain>.workers.dev (matches Preview URL and deployment URLs; 63-char DNS label limit)
base_url.local: explicit known ports, e.g. localhost:5173; Better Auth supports port wildcards but Flare intentionally emits exact ports for a narrower allowlist
base_url.trusted_origins: derived automatically by Better Auth from allowedHosts

protocol.reason: with auto/unset, cookie Secure flag falls back to NODE_ENV==="production", unreliable in Worker bundles

base_url.forwarded_headers: advanced.trustedProxyHeaders left off; Better Auth version pinned; spoofed X-Forwarded-Host/Host outside allowlist must be rejected
base_url.social_login_limit: not supported on per-branch Worker Previews in v1 (single registered OAuth callback); works on production and persistent fullstack preview with separate OAuth apps; email/password works everywhere
base_url.local_values: generated Wrangler env.development selected only by bun dev (CLOUDFLARE_ENV=development inline); vars AUTH_ALLOWED_HOSTS=localhost:<port>, AUTH_PROTOCOL=http; blocks generated from one template; doctor checks parity; build/deploy never inherit CLOUDFLARE_ENV

design_system_lint.role: specialized UI/design-system lint; does not replace Biome
design_system_lint.reason_for_eslint: Oxlint JS plugin API is currently alpha; prefer conservative integration for v1

quality.design_system_linter: @shadcn/lint via minimal ESLint config; remove ESLint when a stable standalone/Oxlint path has equivalent coverage

cross_platform.rule: generator/setup scripts use Bun/TypeScript instead of Unix-only shell assumptions

testing_policy.principle: Add testing deliberately per project; no Vitest/Playwright/browser binaries in the base scaffold.

cli_strategy.reason: cf was released as open beta on 2026-09-28; v1 defaults to the stable Wrangler path

steps: remote migration preflight when DB exists

cloudflare_git.build_command: preset-specific: bun run verify for single-deployable presets; bun check for fullstack
cloudflare_git.fullstack_connection: connect only public web Worker; custom deploy command orchestrates server then web
cloudflare_git.fullstack_build_ownership: deploy command owns the single production Vite build; Workers Builds build command does not pre-build fullstack

previews.single_worker_presets: Cloudflare Worker Previews with explicit previews bindings for mutable resources
previews.fullstack: persistent env.preview pair built by one CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preview Vite build (web + auxiliary server); flare secrets push --env preview uses wrangler secret bulk --name <server-preview-worker-name> before first deploy and for updates; pinned Wrangler may create the draft server-preview Worker; server deploys first, then web
previews.reason: Cloudflare Preview Service Bindings currently resolve to downstream production deployments
previews.fullstack_concurrency: one shared persistent preview pair in v1; concurrent branches can overwrite it
previews.preview_security: X-Robots-Tag noindex,nofollow; Cloudflare Access recommended/opt-in for sensitive previews
previews.single_worker_preview_secrets: flare secrets push --env preview validates .preview.vars then uses wrangler preview base-config secret bulk; bun preview runs wrangler preview without --secrets-file; per-Preview overrides use wrangler preview secret bulk --name
previews.single_worker_preview_secret_update_sema: Preview Base secret changes affect newly created Previews only; active Preview override is explicit
previews.single_worker_preview_secret_verificatio: after every wrangler preview: wrangler preview secret list --name <preview>, compare to secrets.required, repair once via wrangler preview secret bulk --name, re-list, fail if still missing
previews.previews_block_required: always generate previews block for app/worker (empty if no Preview-specific bindings)

scripts.dev: preset-specific; fullstack runs web only because Vite auxiliaryWorkers starts server
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run ui:lint
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run build

checks: /api/health through public web origin for fullstack

fullstack.routes: /api/* forwarded via Service Binding; Hono basePath(/api)
fullstack.build: single Vite build from apps/web includes auxiliary server Worker
fullstack.production_env: top-level Wrangler config; CLOUDFLARE_ENV must be unset
fullstack.preview_env: command-scoped CLOUDFLARE_ENV=preview at Vite build time
fullstack.branch_preview_guard: bun run cloudflare:branch-preview-guard exits without uploading

deployment.compatibility_date_policy: pin per Flare release; omit redundant nodejs_compat flags for >=2026-08-04

order: wrangler secret bulk to explicit production Worker name (draft Worker may be created when absent)
first_deploy.fullstack_secret_owner: server receives required secrets via explicit-name secret bulk before first deploy; web declares no required auth/database secrets
first_deploy.doctor: detects missing required remote secret names and prints flare secrets push --env production
first_deploy.canonical: authenticate -> provision resources -> write IDs -> collect secrets -> secret bulk -> apply production migrations -> build -> ordered Worker deploys -> health checks

owners.flare setup cloudflare: authenticate, provision, write IDs, collect/generate secrets in memory, push with wrangler secret bulk, apply first production migrations after confirmation, offer immediate first deploy
owners.bun deploy: migration preflight, build, ordered deploy, health checks; fails with flare secrets push remediation when required remote secrets are missing

first_deploy.secret_bootstrap: flare secrets push --env production streams values to wrangler secret bulk; no resumable plaintext production-secret file
first_deploy.why_secret_bulk: current pinned Wrangler can create a draft Worker when the target does not exist; Flare fixture-tests this behavior before release

deployment.aux_config_lookup: read dist/*/wrangler.json and match name field; never assume directory name

responsibilities: guide Git repository connection to Workers Builds
disable Preview Builds/non-production branch builds for fullstack connected web Worker
use repository root and no narrowed watch paths for fullstack connected build
push required preview/production secrets before first code deploy

configure Workers Builds via API only where supported; otherwise print exact dashboard values (production branch, non-production builds off or guard command, root directory, build/deploy commands, Neon MIGRATION_STATUS_DATABASE_URL build secret)
create .preview.vars from example with generated preview secrets
first_deploy_order: wrangler secret bulk to explicit production Worker
cloudflare_setup.neon_v1: user supplies preview and production URLs; no Neon management API credential

principles: local development is a product feature
operations and upgrades are part of the starter contract
mutating commands are Git-aware and recoverable
fullstack keeps one public browser origin and uses a Service Binding to the server Worker
Wrangler is the v1 default; cf is experimental opt-in
production deploys are blocked while required database migrations are pending
pre-commit stays staged and fast; full typecheck happens pre-push; build happens at explicit verify/deploy time
manifest stores architectural intent; wrangler stores concrete Cloudflare deployment state
fullstack preview is a single persistent shared v1 environment, not per-branch isolation

observability.extension_behavior: browser code excluded; v1 extension preset has no server workspace
observability.destination: Cloudflare Workers Logs by default; optional explicit drains later
observability.fullstack_request_id: propagate one request ID across Service Binding; web forwarder avoids duplicate full request events

headers.HSTS: not emitted by base scaffold; explicit custom-domain hardening only

header_implementation.static: generated _headers (static assets only); preview build adds X-Robots-Tag; production build never does
header_implementation.api: explicit Hono middleware emits exactly Flare baseline; never bare secureHeaders(); if secureHeaders(options) is used, every unrelated default is disabled and output is fixture-tested
header_implementation.csp_reports: browser console only in v1; no reporting endpoint
header_implementation.hsts: absent in base v1 on workers.dev and custom domains until deliberately enabled

d1.local: canonical repo-root .wrangler/state shared by Vite and Wrangler migration commands

environment_database_rules.cleanup_rule: preview cleanup must never mutate production resources

rollback.retention: refuse if either recorded version is no longer retained; never mix with a mismatched partner

used_by: Worker Preview Base configuration for app/worker
fullstack server-preview normal environment deploy/secret path

strategy.app_worker_previews: wrangler preview base-config secret bulk; per-preview override via wrangler preview secret bulk --name
strategy.fullstack_persistent_preview: wrangler secret bulk <file> --name <server-preview-worker-name> before first deploy and for updates; pinned Wrangler draft-creates target when absent

versioning.pin: exact tested React/TanStack/Wrangler/Cloudflare Vite/shadcn/etc.; cf only if experimental
versioning.dependency_ranges: exact tested versions for Flare-owned core dependencies at scaffold time

compatibility.cloudflare_vite_plugin: exact tested version per Flare release; no unverified minimum
compatibility.nodejs_compat: >=2026-08-04 enabled by date; redundant flags warned/normalized, not treated as runtime errors
compatibility.node_types: @types/node when dependency graph requires Node builtin types
compatibility.wrangler_secret_bulk_draft_bootstrap: pinned-version release fixture; current Wrangler creates a draft Worker when the named Worker does not exist

environment.client_public_example_file: .env.example only when client-visible variables are required

same_origin_default.fullstack: relative /api path through web Worker Service Binding

rules: every required generated key has an actionable comment

third-party credentials remain blank until supplied by the user

command_policy.testing: Generated projects have no bun test script by default.
